name: mangalya
description: Website for Mangalya: Next.js front end and Express API

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
scripts.check:api: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm test --prefix api
scripts.check:web: npm run lint --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web
